what_this_is: AT-HEAD revalidation of the 21 committed chain fixtures against a LIVE trustc dump, measured 2026-09-15. It is NOT a fixture rebaseline and moves no pin: it is the evidence for a CONTENT-SCOPE red raised by scripts/crystal_freshness_scope.py, following the 2026-09-09 lane18r precedent (data/crystal_revalidation_at_head_2026-09-09_lane18r.json).
why_it_was_run: `strict_monads` (env::Environment::set_lean4_core_strict_monads) went CONTENT-SCOPE red because its pinned source ITEMS moved in crates/clean-kernel/src/env/mod.rs: another lane added a `typed_param_names` field to `struct Environment` (0ed84bff1 / 53df61b54). The struct is legitimately in that body's pinned item list -- adding a field can change field offsets and therefore the emitted body -- so the gate was right to ask. This record is the answer.
verdict: FRESH: no chained body's instructions have moved.
what_moved: Only per-BUILD identity: functy-index, loc-file-index, type-table-index, callee-index, global-index and lineage digests. The freshness script states these renumber on any clean-kernel or producer change and are NOT read by the semantics (ir_ty_is_agg_enum_any / ir_ty_is_agg_struct_any prove the type index cannot reach the machine's answer). Same NUMBERING-ONLY shape the 2026-09-09 at-head revalidation recorded.

producer.note: CLAUDE.md records the producer rebuilt from trust c4e667ca51 reproducing lane18's clean_kernel.trust-ir.bin/.txt byte for byte; this dump was taken with that same stamp.
producer.dump_recipe: TRUSTC=<stage2>/bin/trustc TRUST_IR_BUILD_DUMP=<dir> scripts/heavy_gate.sh run 8 crystal-dump -- scripts/trust_ir_build.sh --print-only
producer.cost: 2m57s, observed peak 5.07 GB against an 8 GB reservation

what_this_does_NOT_do: It does NOT clear the scope gate and was not used to. Clearing a CONTENT-SCOPE red needs a NEW data/crystal_chain_revalidation_*.json, and minting one requires a fixture rebaseline record covering the CURRENT clean source rev -- scripts/crystal_chain_revalidation.py refused here with 'fixture rebaseline record covers a different Clean source revision'. That rebaseline is scripts/crystal_fixture_rebaseline.py, a reviewed strict re-pin that re-pins what every link-2a lane compares against, and it belongs to the crystal lane and to the lane that changed `Environment`. This record is what that reviewer needs: the question is already measured.
